bio: I'm a strategy consultant and product manager, with a passion for building customised productivity apps.
I focus on practical tools that fit how people actually work — simple to use, thoughtfully designed, and built to solve real problems.

projectsSection.label: What I've built
projectsSection.title: Projects
projectsSection.subtitle: Custom productivity apps I've designed and shipped.

projects.title: Habit Streaker
projects.summary: A simple habit tracker tailored to my needs — digitising a notebook tracker without the complexity of existing apps.

details.heading: What I built
details.text: I wanted to digitise my habit tracker from a notebook to develop new healthy habits, but found existing solutions too complex and cumbersome. So I built one tailored to my needs that was simple and easy to use.

details.heading: What I learned
details.text: I was originally using Blink to build the app, but realised that Banani + Figma gives me more control over the designs to make finer attunements.

details.heading: What to improve next time
details.text: Because I deliberately kept this simple as a starter project, and the data is stored on the local device, changing my phone meant losing access to the original data and images stopped saving correctly. For later projects, I used Supabase integration to prevent such issues.

projects.title: Eisenhower To-Do
projects.summary: A custom to-do list laid out as an Eisenhower matrix — urgent vs not urgent, important vs not important.

details.heading: What I built
details.text: I wanted to customise my to-do list so that it was in a matrix resembling an Eisenhower matrix — showing urgent/non-urgent tasks, and important/non-important tasks.

details.heading: What I learned
details.text: Getting design proportions right was surprisingly difficult, and I ended up customising the pixels in Figma and importing it to Cursor from there.

details.heading: What to improve next time
details.text: There are still some UX improvements that can be made to make this more usable; this will require a longer trial period to understand key friction points to optimise workflow.

projects.title: RockPebbleSandTrello
projects.summary: A Trello-style life board that visually differentiates big projects from smaller tasks by size and importance.

details.heading: What I built
details.text: I've kept high-level life projects on Trello, but found it cumbersome because it doesn't differentiate between big projects and smaller tasks. To solve this, I've made a Trello board that visually differentiates between projects based on size / importance.

details.heading: What I learned
details.text: I used Supabase to make this multi-device compatible and so the data can persist; though ensuring smooth integration (and ensuring the right interactions in drag & drop action) was surprisingly time-consuming.

details.heading: What to improve next time
details.text: Whilst the board is optimised for web-interface on laptop, the UX is not ideal on mobile devices. Further research on mobile interactions could improve this, but has been deprioritised as it is only used infrequently on mobile devices.
